entries.summary: Developing, architecting, and supporting enterprise and e-commerce web applications across the full stack — from frontend and backend to APIs, authentication, deployment, and production support.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained enterprise and e-commerce applications using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS, covering inventory, billing, product, cart, and payment workflows.
Built reusable and scalable UI components with React.js and Redux-Saga, and integrated AWS AppSync GraphQL APIs for efficient data communication and state synchronization.
Developed backend APIs and implemented JWT authentication and fine-grained RBAC for secure multi-tenant authorization, along with integrations for Razorpay, AWS S3, Nodemailer, and SMS OTP.
Resolved 15+ high-priority production issues, performing root-cause analysis, implementing fixes, and validating solutions across UAT and production environments.
Managed and supported 10+ UAT and production releases using Jenkins, AWS CodeCommit, and Docker, collaborating with development and QA teams throughout release and post-production support.

entries.summary: Built full-stack enterprise applications and reusable frontend architectures, while training and mentoring junior developers and interns.
responsibilities: Developed full-stack enterprise applications using React.js, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, and Java REST APIs, contributing across frontend, backend, and business workflows.
Developed reusable Micro Frontend modules using React.js and TypeScript within a Monorepo architecture, improving modularity and maintainability across application portals.
Designed and implemented ASP.NET Core microservices with Entity Framework Core and PostgreSQL, and integrated gRPC and REST APIs for distributed application communication.
Developed role-based interfaces and workflows, while contributing to debugging, data validation, issue analysis, and application enhancements across recruitment and healthcare applications.
Mentored 10+ junior developers and 15+ interns in JavaScript, React.js, and backend development, supporting them in application architecture, debugging, coding practices, and project implementation.
